content_sections.heading: DHAS Delhi Junior Resident Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the DHAS Delhi Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download DHAS Delhi Junior Resident Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: DHAS Delhi Junior Resident Vacancy Details 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Resident: MBBS from recognized university/institution and must possess valid Registration Certificate from Delhi Medical Council.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 30 years Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, 5 years extra for Persons with Disabilities.

content_sections.heading: DHAS Delhi Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DHAS Delhi Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Resident post at DHAS Delhi?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date, which is 04 August 2026. There is no separate application form submission deadline before the walk-in.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Resident position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognized university or institution and hold a valid Registration Certificate from the Delhi Medical Council.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the Junior Resident position at Dr. Hedgewar Arogya Sansthan (DHAS Delhi).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Resident post is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Resident role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Resident post ranges from Rs. 56,100 to Rs. 1,77,500 per month, plus applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs. This includes ID proof, educational certificates, and registration certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Dr. Hedgewar Arogya Sansthan, Delhi, with the pincode 110032. The exact venue details will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of this job?
faq.answer: The job is on an Ad-hoc basis.
